passage: Materials and Methods: Retrospective study was conducted in Department of Pathology (Blood bank) of J.K. Hospital. Medical records of 200 patients who received FFP were studied. FFP usage was classified as appropriate or inappropriate based on guidelines by National Health and Medical Research Council and The Australasian Society for Blood Transfusion. Pre-and post transfusion INR were recorded and effect of FFP on the pre-transfusion INR was studied in patients who appropriately received FFP. Relationship between pre-transfusion INR and improvement in the INR per unit of FFP was studied using Pearson’s correlation. Holland and brooks formula was used in determining corrected INR.
